AAB: Code specifying that the price is inclusive of tax.
AAC: The suggested retail price as suggested or determined by the party purchasing the goods.
AAD: The charges imposed by the ocean transportation industry above and beyond the basic freight.
AAE: Not subject to escalation or adjustment.
AAF: Subject to increase or development by successive stages.
EUP: The anticipated value of a single item.
AAH: Subject to increase or development by successive stages and price adjustment.
AAI: Code specifying that the fluctuation conditions are not identified.
AAK: A price valid from an effective date/time/period.
AAL: A price valid prior to an effective date/time/period of a new price.
NE: Code specifying a price that cannot be increased.
AAN: Price can be obtained on request from seller.
AAO: The price given is the price of the item without packaging.
RES: Price per unit of quantity of a product to be used for resale.
AAQ: Price which will remain unchanged for a given time period.
AAR: The per unit cost of referenced material based on a given quotation for that material.
AAS: The labour component of the per-unit item price.
QTE: Price per unit of quantity of a product as specified in a quote.
AAU: The packing component of the per-unit item price.
AAV: The tooling component of the per-unit item price.
AAW: The component of a price charged for providing a temporary vehicle.
FCR: The price that is either a freight rate or a rate on which freight charges are calculated.
SHD: To transport goods and be owed money by the customer for the services performed.
NW: Code specifying a net weight price.
SRP: Price per unit of quantity of a product suggested for retail.
PBQ: The starting amount at which you can place a value on a single item.
CP: Price at time of transaction, but subject to future change.
MAX: The greatest amount of goods or services which one can buy to receive a certain value.
AAM: To indicate that the given price applies per week.
CON: Price per unit of quantity of a product/service as agreed in a contract between parties.
MXR: The greatest amount of an order that one can place in order to receive a certain value.
AAP: Discount price available to all customers except the retail customer.
MSR: Price that reflects "Sales to other manufacturers" or "Sales for resale".
OFR: The price per pricing unit of ocean transportation services for moving cargo from one location to another.
AAG: Code specifying that the price is subject to adjustment.
MNR: The least amount of an order one can place in order to receive a certain value.
MIN: The least amount of goods or services that one can buy to receive a certain value.
ABA: A price which is available to an individual buyer as opposed to an institutional buyer.
ABB: A price which is available to a buying group.
TB: Code specifying that the price has to be negotiated.
ABD: A special price if pre-payment is made for the article ordered.
ABE: Retail price not including any applicable taxes.
ABF: Suggested retail price not including any applicable taxes.
ABG: The minimum price agreed between trading partners.
ABI: A code to indicate that the price represents the reimbursement of the actual costs incurred.
ABJ: A code to indicate that the given price is applicable under normal competitive conditions.
ABK: A code to indicate that the price mentioned has been submitted in the context of an open tender.
ABL: The base price of a product or service.
ABM: The difference in price against a base price.
ABN: A price which can be adjusted due to economic conditions between the date of offer and the date of acceptance.
ABO: A price which can be revised due to economic conditions between the date of acceptance of the order and the date of delivery.
ABP: A provisional price which cannot be exceeded.
ABQ: A provisional price which cannot be exceeded but which can be adjusted due to economic conditions between the date of offer and the date of acceptance.
ABR: A provisional price which cannot be exceeded but is revisable due to economic conditions between the date of acceptance of the order through to the date of delivery.
ABS: A provisional price which is revisable due to economic conditions between the date of acceptance of the order and the date of delivery.
ABU: Price connected to a geographical area.
PRO: The value that the maker of a good places on an item.
PRP: The value that is placed on an item that is being developed. The idea is to sell this product for less than one normally would, and make up for it by selling a larger quantity.
TW: Code specifying a price based on a theoretical weight.
EC: Price registered at European Commission Steel and Carbon office (DG III).
ABZ: The price applicable to the power generated as a result of a downward balance regulation.
AAX: This is the component of the price which is charged due to interest.
DPR: A reduction from the usual list value.
AAY: This is the component of the price which is charged due to management services rendered.
AAZ: This is the component of the price which is charged due to maintenance.
NTP: Unit price to which no allowances and charges apply.
DIS: The cost associated with the agency that markets goods.
DAP: The necessary or desirable changes that the sales agency makes with respect to the value of the product.
CAT: Price per unit of quantity of a product as specified in a catalogue.
PPD: The cost of shipping is paid before the goods are shipped.
DSC: A certain price up to which one is able to make reductions from the usual list value.
CUS: A clearly known duty on a single item which is imposed by law.
PPR: Price per unit of quantity of a product as provisionally agreed.
CUP: The value of a single item that proves to be correct.
ABC: A special price given to a member of a buying group.
CDV: The present worth of a thing which comes from one's homeland, in terms of money or goods.
LBL: Retail price of the buyer that should be printed by the producer on the article's label. The labelling price is not necessary the effective retail price.
CU: Code specifying that the price is based on consumer unit.
PAQ: Numerical amounts of goods or services which are associated with different sums of money. As the amount goes up, the price per individual item decreases.
ACA: The agreed minimum retail price for an article.
ACB: The retail price of a product which has been marked on the products packaging.
ABT: A provisional price which is adjustable due to economic conditions between the date of offer and the date of acceptance.
TRF: To carry or remove from one place, situation, or person to another.
TU: Code specifying a traded unit price.
GRP: Unit price to which allowances and charges apply.
ABW: The price applicable to the power generated as a result of a special balance regulation.
AAT: The transport component of the per-unit item price.
ABX: The price applicable to the power generated as a result of a balance regulation.
PW: Code specifying a gross weight price.
ABY: The price applicable to the power generated as a result of an upward balance regulation.
AI: Code specifying that price is based on the active ingredient.
RTP: Price per unit of quantity of a product to be used for retail.
ABV: A basis price applied to a geographic area.
INV: Price per unit of quantity of a product as specified on an invoice.
